devLogin.title: Development: sign in by employee ID
devLogin.hint: No password. Only shown locally when CSA_DEV_LOGIN=true; production has no such entry (Q82)

login.help:
Group employees can sign in with their employee ID; the account and password are shared with the OMS organisation master.
If it says not enabled yet, ask the system maintainer to enable CSA for you.

admin.title: 🔑 Admin sign-in
admin.subtitle: For the system admin account only; it belongs to no employee

assessments.heading: {{year}} {{plant}} {{code}} {{name}}
assessments.readOnlyNote: Control points are read-only for now.
assessments.notFound: This assessment does not exist or you are not allowed to view it

nextLaunch.note: The {{subject}} edited here are used by the next launch and top-ups; assessments already issued are not affected. For past years, open that year's assessment in <records>Assessment records</records>.

typeToDelete.typePhrase: Type the grey text in the box yourself to confirm (pasting is disabled)

templates.title: Templates
templates.name: Name
templates.unitsRequired: A control point under control activities needs at least one assessing unit
templates.addUnitToPoint: Choose an assessing unit to add
templates.unitsOrderHint: This order is the row order on the answer sheet and the PDF; drag ⠿ or use ↑↓ to change it.
templates.empty: No templates to show (only audit admins can see template management)
templates.notFound: This template does not exist or you are not allowed to view it
templates.componentChoiceHint: Per Article 6 of the Regulations Governing Establishment of Internal Control Systems by Public Companies. Control activities cover the operating cycles and have different answer columns from the other four, so a template cannot move between control activities and the others once created.
templates.componentFixedControl: Control activities have different answer columns from the other four components, so this template cannot move to another component.
templates.componentFixedElement: It can move among these four; control activities have different answer columns, so it cannot become one.
templates.unclassifiedHint: These templates have no component yet; open the template, press "Edit" and choose one under "Edit header".
templates.statusHint: Only active templates appear in the annual launch; deactivating one does not affect assessments already issued.
templates.factoryCodesHint: Pick or type OMS plant codes (e.g. FQ, KH-HW); the plant master source is not settled yet (Q68).
templates.limitedPlantsHint: Only the plants you run; for a template that applies to other plants or all plants, ask the 稽核主管.
templates.dragHint: Drag ⠿ to reorder sections and control points.
templates.sectionLevelHint: Level 1 is a card; levels 2 and 3 are sub-headings inside it
templates.codeHint: As on the paper form; leave blank to number automatically
templates.deleteSubsectionsFirst: It still heads sub-sections: delete or move them first
templates.sectionEmpty: This section has no control points yet
templates.deleteSectionConfirm: Delete this section and its {{count}} control points?
templates.elementUnitHint: Optional outside control activities, and there may be several; to have one self-checker answer it, give every control point of the template the same assessing unit.

units.title: Assessing units
units.hint: Shared across the group and unrelated to OMS departments; control points pick their assessing unit from here (required under control activities, optional for the other components).
units.name: Assessing unit
units.duplicate: An assessing unit with this name already exists
units.inUse: This assessing unit is still used by control points or approval routes and cannot be deleted

templates.onlyInactive: Only inactive templates exist; turn on "Show inactive templates" above to see them

deleteTemplate.title: Delete template {{code}} {{name}}
deleteTemplate.onlyUnused: Only a template that was never used can be deleted: no assessment issued and no approval route. Deactivate a used template instead; deleting cannot be undone.
deleteTemplate.contents: This also deletes {{sections}} sections, {{points}} control points and the applicable plants.
deleteTemplate.inUse: Already in use, deactivate it instead: this template has issued assessments or an approval route
deleteTemplate.inUseHint: This template has issued assessments or an approval route and cannot be deleted; deactivate it under "Edit" → "Edit header" instead

errors.duplicateTemplate: A template with this code already exists (one template per code)
errors.inUse: Still in use elsewhere, cannot be deleted
errors.unitRule: Control points under control activities need an assessing unit
errors.componentLayout: A template cannot move between control activities and the other components: their answer columns differ
errors.forbidden: Only audit admins can change templates
errors.stale: This page is out of date; reload and try again

templates.sameContentHint: Lists the other plants whose current sections, questions and assessing units are identical (inactive templates excluded). It is recompared from the current content every time the list opens; one different character makes them differ. Check it before editing to see which plants may need the same change; once edited, a template no longer matches, so this column does not remember plants that used to be the same.

plants.loadError: Could not load the plants, so the list is not split by plant: {{error}}
